description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart summarizing categories related to multi-turn, entangled instruction-following, with an inner ring showing three high-level groups and an outer ring showing eight specific task types. The inner ring contains 3 slices labeled “Contradiction Resolution” (reddish-brown), “Context Tracking” (dark blue), and “Context Retrieving” (dark teal/green), with no percentages printed and the slices appearing roughly similar in size. The outer ring contains 8 slices, each labeled with a task name and a numeric value next to it: “Prioritization” (light pink, 100), “Personalization” (salmon, 100), “Privacy Protection” (red, 111), “Multitasking” (green-teal, 100), “Dynamic Instruction” (bright teal, 100), “Memorization” (light cyan, 100), “Dynamic Environment” (deep blue, 100), and “Recursive Reasoning” (bright blue, 110); these outer slices also appear approximately equal in angular size despite the differing numbers. Labels are placed outside the donut with leader lines, there is no separate legend, and no slice is visibly exploded or otherwise emphasized.
